options.name: host
options.help: bind address (default %(default)s)

options.name: port
options.help: Modbus TCP port (default %(default)s)

options.name: unit
options.help: Modbus unit id served (default %(default)s)

options.name: profile
options.help: inverter profile JSON: name -> register (+ optional type/scale), e.g. profiles/profiles/sun2000.json (the default); PROFILE when unset

options.name: max-kwp
options.help: PV array size in kWp, peak = 75%% of it (default %(default)s)

options.name: timezone
options.help: clock the state machines integrate over (the PV bell, the home load, the clouds, the battery, the grid voltage): UTC (the default) or the local wall clock

options.name: time
options.help: freeze simulated time HH:MM (default: real clock)

options.name: time-scale
options.help: the simulated clock speed: N times real time - every machine (the battery, the clouds, the voltages, the day counters) integrates over it, so a full simulated day takes 24/N real hours (default: 1 = real time)

options.name: static
options.help: constant demo values instead of the day simulation

options.name: battery
options.help: simulate a battery (the default)

options.name: no-battery
options.help: no battery values

options.name: battery-kwh
options.help: usable battery capacity in kWh (default %(default)s)

options.name: strict
options.help: reject reads of undefined registers with exception 02 (like the real device)

options.name: chaos
options.help: probability 0..1 that a request is answered hostile and dropped (default: off); seed with --seed for reproducibility

options.name: grid-voltage
options.help: nominal grid phase voltage in V (120 or 230; the per-phase machine wanders ±10 %% around it, default %(default)s)

options.name: grid-frequency
options.help: nominal grid frequency in Hz (the machine wanders ±0.2 Hz around it, default %(default)s)

options.name: seed
options.help: chaos RNG seed (default: random)

options.name: connect-acl
options.help: the Modbus clients allowed to connect (the cache's connect-acl, mirrored): "any" (the default — the trusted-LAN posture), "none", or a comma-separated list of IPs and CIDR prefixes, e.g. 127.0.0.1,10.48.0.0/16 (env CONNECT_ACL)

options.name: max-clients
options.help: refuse further Modbus connections past this many simultaneous clients, 0 = no limit (default %(default)s)

options.name: client-timeout
options.help: disconnect Modbus clients silent for this many seconds, 0 = never (default %(default)s) — sheds connections from clients that died without closing

options.name: max-conn-per-ip
options.help: refuse further Modbus connections from one peer IP past this many simultaneous connections, 0 = no per-IP limit (default %(default)s)

options.name: control-port
options.help: control server target: unix socket path (default: /tmp/fake-inverter-<modbus-port>.socket) or TCP port number on 127.0.0.1 (e.g. 15599); 0 = off. Talk to it with modbus-fake-ctl.py

options.name: control-token
options.help: require a token on control connections: the client authenticates with {"cmd": "auth", "token": ...}; over the unix socket a trusted peer (root, the daemon's own user or --control-trust-uids — SO_PEERCRED) skips the token

options.name: control-token-file
options.help: the token from a file (the first line; e.g. a systemd LoadCredential or a key file; must be owner-only 0600) — takes the place of --control-token; giving both is an error (env CONTROL_TOKEN_FILE)

options.name: control-ops-token
options.help: a second, read-only control token: sessions authenticating with it may run the show/clear verbs only (no set/unset, no reset, no shutdown) — the ops shift against the admin key, both audited (env CONTROL_OPS_TOKEN)

options.name: control-ops-token-file
options.help: the read-only ops token from a file (the first line; must be owner-only 0600) — takes the place of --control-ops-token; giving both is an error (env CONTROL_OPS_TOKEN_FILE)

options.name: control-ops-verbs
options.help: the read-only ops role's RBAC policy: the verbs its sessions may run, comma-separated (default: show,clear; validated against the control grammar at start; env CONTROL_OPS_VERBS)

options.name: control-trust-uids
options.help: extra peer uids the unix control socket trusts without the token (SO_PEERCRED — a local systemd unit speaks without the secret); root and the daemon's own user are always trusted (env CONTROL_TRUST_UIDS)

options.name: control-socket-group
options.help: leave the unix control socket group-accessible (chmod 0660 instead of the default 0600): a local group may speak to the control without being the service user

options.name: control-log-replies
options.help: DEBUG-log the full output of every control command (the default logs the command only)

options.name: metrics-server
options.help: serve the fake's own Prometheus /metrics endpoint (the live `set metrics-server` toggle exists too); off by default

options.name: metrics-listen
options.help: the metrics bind address HOST:PORT (default %(default)s)

options.name: metrics-token
options.help: require Authorization: Bearer <token> on the /metrics endpoint (the same scheme the scraper speaks)

options.name: metrics-token-file
options.help: the metrics bearer token from a file (the first line; must be owner-only 0600) — takes the place of --metrics-token; giving both is an error (env METRICS_TOKEN_FILE)

options.name: metrics-max-clients
options.help: maximum concurrent HTTP clients on the /metrics endpoint; extras get an immediate 503, 0 = unlimited (default %(default)s)

options.name: metrics-client-timeout
options.help: seconds an idle /metrics client is kept before the socket times out, 0 = the built-in 5 s cap (default %(default)s)

options.name: metrics-max-conn-per-ip
options.help: maximum concurrent /metrics connections from one peer IP, 0 = no per-IP limit (default %(default)s)

options.name: audit-log
options.help: INV audit trail: a file path or - for stdout (the docker/journald way); default: ~/.local/state/fake-inverter/audit.log — the XDG state home

options.name: audit-max-mb
options.help: rotate the audit log at this size in MB, keeping 3 backups; 0 = no size rotation (default %(default)s)

options.name: audit-daily
options.help: also rotate the audit log at UTC midnight

options.name: audit-files
options.help: rotated audit backups to keep (default %(default)s)

options.name: no-audit-log
options.help: disable the INV audit trail
